reviews.comment: Took him for GEOG 352 as well as GEOG 312. He is definitely a kind, knowledgeable professor, but I felt he taught the 352 material better than the 312 material. I would often not understand what he was teaching and some of the assignments we had to do were really confusing at times. He would provide code often for them, but it didn't always help.

The material can get confusing and he didn't really do great job at teaching it, I'd get lost and not learn anything in the lectures. Some of the labs are super easy and some are the most confusing, lengthiest things ever. However, easy to keep up an A (quizlets) and he's very understanding, plus gives extra credit opportunities!

Dr. Ma is knowledgeable, kind, and understanding. He responded to emails quickly and gave good personal advice. However, the content was extremely difficult, and lectures were hard to follow and not engaging. Labs took a long time, and the instructions were very confusing, but my TA (Brendan) was really helpful.

As registration approaches, I want to say that Dr. Ma is a great professor so far. I think that he is very knowledgeable. You need to actively engage with the presented content in order to get anything out of them which is what should be done in college anyways. Checks for understanding during lectures as well, so I wouldn't skip. Overall: good!
reviews.ratingTags: Beware of pop quizzes--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: For his first-time teaching, Dr. Ma taught this class pretty well. He's nice and allows some assignments to be resubmitted for a higher grade. Very understanding when unexpected circumstances came up and responds to emails quickly. Labs were tough simply because TA did not help with them and were written by a professor that left the department.

Professor Ma is new to teaching and starting teaching GEOG-351 to replace a previous Professor that left to a different department somewhat suddenly. Because of this the class did not feel completely organized and the labs were chaotic at best. Professor Ma's lectures were informative but somewhat bland. My lab TA had no idea what he was doing tho.
